description: Intent i005 (if-alt-count, snapshot s01) complete. Two reported findings of the interface/altsetting-level form of the seed cx231xx invariant, both in gspca subdrivers: (1) drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:318-348 — stv06xx_isoc_init/stv06xx_isoc_nego index actconfig->intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1] (literal 1, never checked against usb_interface_cache.num_altsetting) and then alt->endpoint[0] (never checked against bNumEndpoints) to read and write wMaxPacketSize before usb_set_interface(dev, iface, 1); the gspca core only bounds the alt indexes it picks itself via build_isoc_ep_tb/ep_tb and its num_altsetting>1 guard at gspca.c:894 covers only the set-interface call, not the subdriver dereference. Confidence high. (2) drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2639-2694 — identical copied pattern (sd_isoc_init line 2657, sd_isoc_nego line 2680), no num_altsetting/bNumEndpoints validation anywhere in the subdriver; confidence medium. Both give OOB read/write past the descriptor flex-array at first stream start via a gadget matching the drivers' device_table VID/PIDs, plus a stale/desynced cached wMaxPacketSize after the alt switch. Both quotes verified literal in the cited ranges. Eleven other concrete candidates classified: usbvision, usbtv, ftdi_sio, ims-pcu, cx231xx (seed family, excluded, and in fact properly guarded by idx<max_iad_interface_count=bNumInterfaces), friio, m920x, em28xx-audio, gspca core = safe with file:line evidence; ueagle-atm.c:2209 = unresolved (interface[0]/altsetting[0] in-bounds; its unchecked endpoint[0] belongs to the fixed-epidx-rest branch). Bounded limitations: no compile/gadget reproducer run (read-only snapshot; line-level reasoning + usb.h flex-array layout evidence only), and runtime S_ALT/set_alt consumers (sound/usb, cdc_ncm MBIM, qcserial, sierra) were enumerated by grep but not deep-read — recorded in the artifact's limitations list.
